definition: things wrapped together in one package
description: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.
transcript: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.
